name: Era milyh veschej
source:
So, what is Moe Era about?
Why, it's about cute things and having fun!
And, of course, a deep, intriguing story!
A story that makes you think...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159660/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
那么，《Moe Era》究竟讲些什么呢？
当然是可爱的事物，以及快乐的时光！
当然，也少不了一个深刻而引人入胜的故事！
一个发人深省的故事…

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159660/]Steam[/url]]
